exemptions.reason: the interpreter worker's own JavaScript source carried as one template literal: the window names the node:vm context the worker runs scripts in, never an rf document, and the literal is executed, never displayed

residuals.family: equality stated over a noun outside the reading's document nouns (the rendered text, the output, the render)
an equality word more than the window's three words from a document noun
an equality synonym outside the reading's equality words (untouched, matches, byte for byte)
a look-alike letter or an inserted invisible inside a word splits it under the fold, so the word is not read (fullwidth letters fold to ASCII under NFKC and are read)
a reuse term and an equality claim in different sentences are never paired
a denial phrase or a producer field anywhere in the unit admits it, whatever it qualifies

a src or qa claim assembled at runtime from non-literal parts is invisible to the literal scan (a + chain's string literals are read together like a template expression's literal parts; the adapter's and native-evidence's surfaced text is still read, A3 and A6)

files outside the scanned trees (test/, dist/, node_modules/ and every dot directory but .agents/, .beads/ and .pi/: .github/, .codex/, tool state such as .forge/) and files of other extensions (qa's four .sh and one .json, any .cjs or .tsx) are not judged

the adapter's rf-output reference is a plain-text digest, so equal references are equal text only (README.md:51's strictly weaker equality); no Pi surface compares two references today and the lexical legs would not see a comparison that states no equality word

markup the rendered reading does not resolve as CommonMark renders it (an inline HTML tag, inside a word, unchanged, or carrying attribute words between two words; a named character reference other than & < > " '  , docu­ment; a bracket inside a code span or inside angle-bracket markup (an HTML tag, an autolink) within a link's text, which CommonMark keeps inside the text; a full or collapsed reference link whose label no definition carries, which CommonMark shows with its label while the reading drops the label) splits, hides, adds or drops a word, so a claim is not read
a reuse synonym outside the reading's reuse terms (memoized, served from the cache, carried over) leaves the sentence out of the docs census

a module that reads an rf envelope without spelling the schema guard in code (the REACTIVE_FIBER_CLI_SCHEMA constant or its value), checking only the context.render command for instance, is outside the A6 reader set

a producer-field or counter read whose spelling is assembled at runtime from anything but adjacent string literals in one + chain (a variable, a call, a template substitution) is invisible to the B3 and A7 spelling readings, code tokens and whole-file alike
